_comment: Paste this array into mllm.tools when starting the Agora Conversational AI agent. Also set advanced_features.enable_tools = true. Base URL must be publicly reachable OR you run the agent locally against a tunnel.

function.name: getGuestContext
function.description: Look up the room and the in-house guest in it: name, tier, rate, checkout date, comps already given, and any open department tasks on that room. Always call this first when the manager names a room.

function.name: findAvailableRooms
function.description: List vacant rooms in the requested category, split into matches on the requested floor, same-category rooms on other floors, and upgrade options. Returns empty lists when nothing is free - report that honestly.

floor.description: Preferred floor, e.g. 4. Omit if the manager does not care.

function.name: getPolicy
function.description: Search the hotel operations policy manual. Use before any compensation, upgrade, room move or escalation decision. Never state a rupee limit from memory.

topic.description: e.g. 'comp limit for gold guest', 'room move rule', 'escalation'

function.name: moveRoom
function.description: Move an in-house guest to a vacant room. Sets the old room to out_of_service. Fails if the target room is not vacant - read available_now and retry with a valid room, or ask the manager.

function.name: createDepartmentTask
function.description: Raise a work order for housekeeping or maintenance with an SLA clock.

function.name: applyComp
function.description: Record a guest compensation in INR. The server enforces the tier ceiling: if it returns APPROVAL_REQUIRED, stop and ask the duty manager to approve explicitly, then call again with approved_by set to their name.

approved_by.description: Only set after the manager has verbally approved an amount above the ceiling.

function.name: scheduleFollowup
function.description: Set a reminder to verify something later, e.g. check that a repair is done.
